c74object.name: evi_hardclip
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Anti-aliased hard clipping function
c74object.description:
evi_hardclip is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_hardclip.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_interp.genexpr
evi_hardclip is also available in MSP as: evi.hardclip~.
To be used whenever clamping of audio is required, evi.hardclip~ should do a good job of protecting your precious audio. This is because this is antialiased hard clipping capable of high input gain whilst maintaining audio quality. evi.hardclip~ is the hard clipping section from the evi.clipper~ object but with more antiderivative and oversampling options for when managing audio quality against CPU usage, selected via the @aa attribute. Increasing @aa does not necessarily translate to 'better'. Experiment with this setting depending on your audio input material.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input to be treated nicely. Any audio input.

attribute.name: aa
attribute.description: 'aa' stands for 'Anti-Aliasing'. Select type (or 'strength') here. 0=1st order antiderivative, 1=1st order 2x oversampled, 2=1st order 4x oversampled, 3=2nd order antiderivative (default), 4=2nd order 2x oversampled, 5=2nd order 4x oversampled.
